name: Wayfarer

components.pose: She walks along an old road through her homeland with a pack on one shoulder, glancing back at the camera mid-stride, dust and weather on her boots; full figure visible.
components.effects: A little swirling frost, snowflakes and ice crystals stirs at her heels and {{MAGIC}} light glints faintly along her gear.

notes: REALM SERIES: Wayfarer in her ice homeland (road); realistic, from realms/ice-lands and backgrounds/fantasy/country/ice.
